name: Hookbelly Triumph
description: Open with both kukri falling together so the right edge leads by a finger's width.

name: Inwardcurve Pledge
description: Cross the spines to form a small window and let the strike break on their joint.

name: Squall Cho
description: Move each foot with the blade on its side so the pair advances as one body.

name: Unbending Slash
description: Hook the lead arm with the left belly and light qi so the right blade has a clear line.

name: Bulgeedge Verdict
description: Echo the left cut with a right cut that follows through the same gap a breath later.

name: Squall Forwardbelly
description: Send a pulse of qi through both blades and sweep a strike wide with the joined edges.

name: Slashbanner
description: Alternate cuts of left and right blade in a steady beat that hems the foe into one spot.

name: Magnificent Pommelcap
description: Close both qi-charged edges on one weapon like shears and cut through the shaft.

name: Stately Kinkspine
description: Receive a strike on one blade and return it on the opposite blade with added weight.

name: Thunderclap Gash
description: Cross the distance in a flash of linked qi and strike with both blades on arrival.

name: Lordly Heavytip
description: Bring both blades down on a single beat of the pulse with qi the student can bear.

name: Squall Whump
description: Let the chop flow out of a loose shoulder so it falls without any visible tension.

name: Peal Horntang
description: Skip a strike off the spine as a flat stone skips across a pond.

name: Lopstroke Grace
description: Cross in short sure steps as over a ford and keep the blade low beside the knee.

name: Squallnotch
description: Pour qi through the blade and hew in a run of strokes with no pause between them.

name: Chiptroth
description: Draw the belly back against the current of the foe's push and send him stumbling.

name: Steel Forwardbelly
description: Spin the blade in a fine curtain of qi that turns thrown darts and thin blades.

name: Quenched Whump
description: Hew down through a guard with the sudden force of a weir giving way.

name: Bedrock Notch
description: Cut two streams of attack that meet at one point on the target in the same instant.

name: Kinkedict
description: Draw qi through a held breath and send a spreading reap across the whole ground ahead.

name: Noble Quenched Chopmass
description: Let the whole stored flow of qi that the student can hold fall in one chop.

name: Notchverdict
description: Chop from a high perch with the weight of the whole fall behind the edge.

name: Steelcho
description: Carry the spine up like a pinion to stop a blow from the side.

name: Crushing Heavytip
description: Hook the foe's elbow with the curved point like a talon and pull it from the guard.

name: Peal Pommelcap
description: Sight down the arm to the chosen target and wait for the instant to dive.

name: Squallwaist
description: Rise on a column of qi and cut upward through the guard from beneath.

name: Steel Bulgeedge
description: Circle the foe in a glide and strike once from the quarter that is least guarded.

name: Choverdict
description: Fold the arms to the chest and release them into a fall of cuts that begin at the shoulder.

name: Prism Chip
description: Mark one point on the foe and drive the blade into it along a straight diving line.

name: Haemalchip
description: Dive and break away then dive again so the second chop meets a guard still in recovery.

name: Squall Inwardcurve
description: Turn a heavy blow upward on a rising pulse of qi and chop down at the same instant.

name: Thunderclap Kinkspine
description: Flash from a high guard to the rear of the foe and chop as the afterimage dissolves.

name: Steel Hookbelly
description: Dive in the school's last stoop with every ounce of qi the student can safely commit.

name: Thunderclap Slash
description: Settle the weight into the belly and chop so that the edge arrives like a falling stone.

name: Sacrosanct Cho
description: Parry along the left track and push the foe's blade off toward his own flank.

name: Evanescent Lopstroke
description: Pivot the heavy body on the lead foot to bring the blade round at once.

name: Steelchip
description: Carry the weight on one qi track while the second track guards the arm that swings.

name: Steel Chopmass
description: Send half the qi to the spine and half to the belly and stop a strike on the joined edge.

name: Venom Hookbelly
description: Hook a leading wrist and cut across the body in one pull that unbalances the foe.

name: Kinktriumph
description: Cross the two tracks at the top of the swing and drop the full pair of weights through the edge.

name: Sundering Cho
description: Take a blow on the guard track and chop on the cutting track in the same motion.

name: Pulsarwhump
description: Gather both tracks into the belly and fall in a rending cut that goes through plate and bone.

name: Bedrock Gash
description: Unite the two tracks at the instant of contact and crush the guard with one stroke.

name: Splendid Inwardcurve Decree
description: Join every track the student can hold into a single edge at the end of a heavy chop.

name: Chip Verdict
description: Chop from the rim of the qi field into the foe who steps across it.

name: Unwavering Horntang
description: Press the spine into the thickened field and check a blow before it reaches the hand.

name: Silken Notch
description: Glide in low over the ground and rise at the foe's reach.

name: Interstice Pommelcap
description: Spread the qi field wide and read every foe it touches from the push of their own qi.

name: Waisttriumph
description: Leap from the rim of the field and dive onto the nearest foe with a chop at the end.

name: Phantasm Bulgeedge
description: Draw the field in around the blade and return a strike's weight in a snap of the wrist.

name: Haemal Chopmass
description: Ring the foe with the field and fall through the ring in a chop that cannot be stepped away from.

name: Ruinous Notch
description: Draw the field into the blade and release it outward in a ring of cuts.

name: Season Kinkspine
description: Flash across the whole field and strike from its far edge with the blade already falling.

name: Fearless Demolition Gash
description: Pull the whole field in on the blade and loose it as a single dive of cuts.

name: Inferno Slash
description: Lead each chop from the seat of the Core so that both curves fall with the same weight.

name: Mighty Forwardbelly
description: Seat the cross of the blades on the Core and take a heavy blow without moving.

name: Delugewhump
description: Turn from the center line of the body and bring both blades round at once.

name: Eclipse Heavytip
description: Feel the beat of the opponent's qi through the crossed blades and read its source.

name: Vaunted Horntang
description: Cut a curve with one blade and its mirror with the other so the foe has no straight line to guard.

name: Savage Kinkspine
description: Hook a weapon with both curves and draw it in on a flow of Core qi.

name: Sainted Cho
description: Hold the Core pulse steady and sweep each strike aside with a flick of the curves.

name: Seasonkink
description: Pulse the Core in time with alternating cuts until the foe is forced to retreat.

name: Prism Gash
description: Burst Core qi into both edges and cleave a shield and the arm behind it in one pass.

name: Kinkseal
description: Catch a strike on one curve and send back its force through the mirror curve as a cut.

name: Feather Notch
description: Pass through the foe's guard in a flash lit by Core qi and cut from the far side.

name: Lordly Magma Chip
description: Pour the whole Core into both curves and sweep them in a single closing circle.

name: Sovereign Lopstroke
description: Speak the oath at the top of the swing and let it fall with the blade.

name: Faithful Bulgeedge
description: Meet a blow in the plateau stance and let it break on the planted weight.

name: Ethereal Pommelcap
description: Step with the wind behind the shoulders so the lunge lengthens by a hand.

name: Whump Decree
description: Lend qi to the gust behind the blade so the hew falls faster than the eye can follow.

name: Rending Hookbelly
description: Hook the foe's arm in the notch and pull it against the sworn weight of the stance.

name: Steel Horntang
description: Stand still with qi held in the legs and let the first rush of the foe fall on the blade.

name: Vigor Slash
description: Gather the push of a rising squall into the shoulders and bring it down in a chop.

name: Heavytip Pledge
description: Take the strike on the notch and return it on the next gust as a hew across the guard.

name: Interstice Forwardbelly
description: Cross the gap in a flash on a gust of qi and hew as the wind settles.

name: Vigornotch
description: Pledge the full qi the student can bear to one last hew carried on the wind.

name: Bedrock Chopmass
description: Chop down in the plain form with the feet planted and nothing wasted.

name: Haemal Inwardcurve
description: Hack with the heel of the edge toward the foe who stands at the edge of reach.

name: Inviolate Hookbelly
description: Turn a strike down the spine and let it slide to the ground.

name: Searing Chip
description: Move over open ground in a measured pace that keeps the blade at one angle.

name: Haemalcho
description: Mark the wind's direction on the cheek and chop in line with it for extra weight.

name: Slashpledge
description: Hook a leading leg in the curve and drag it along the plateau floor.

name: Parity Kinkspine
description: Hold the blade along one bearing while qi in the arm turns aside blow after blow.

name: Inferno Chopmass
description: Roll cut after cut off the sworn stance without a step so none leaves the line.

name: Vigor Whump
description: Gather qi at the crown of the head and release it in a hew down the whole body.

name: Tempestuous Chip
description: Sweep the blade in a wide arc under the open sky and clear the ground around the stance.

name: Vacuum Forwardbelly
description: Stand on the edge of reach and rend the guard with a cut that seems to fall from further than the arm.

name: Splendid Cho
description: Close the plateau forms with a last hew built from every rung the student has climbed.

name: Haemal Slash
description: Set the bearing on the foe's shoulder and chop down the line with no deviation.

name: Deluge Pommelcap
description: Hold the blade on the bearing and let each strike slide along its length.

name: Titan Heavytip
description: Tack across the foe's front in short zigzag steps and keep the bearing on his chest.

name: Gallant Horntang
description: Cut across the wind and let it lean the blade onto a line the foe did not expect.

name: Vigor Lopstroke
description: Reset the bearing in the middle of a swing and backhand along the new line.

name: Chomercy
description: Read the gusts on the edge and predict where the foe will be a moment from now.

name: Thrallwaist
description: Hook the foe's arm and hold it on the heading until the blade comes round to cut.

name: Steelwaist
description: Hold a bearing through a breath of qi and send the blade down it in one piercing hew.

name: Prismcho
description: Meet a blow and reverse the bearing so the force returns along its path as a chop.

name: Lopstroke Decree
description: Cut a line through dust and wind with qi that holds the bearing against all push.

name: Magnificent Steel Notch
description: Hold the chosen bearing with all the qi the student can spare and chop along it.

name: Waistbanner
description: Hew from a bare stance with nothing to lean on and no place to hide.

name: Hookbelly Troth
description: Block squarely on the flat of the blade since there is nowhere else to stand.

name: Chipgrace
description: Slide along the foe's exposed flank to cut before his guard can turn.

name: Famed Bulgeedge
description: Cut in plain sight with qi that makes the edge bite harder than it looks.

name: Peremptory Whump
description: Open the free hand and hook with the blade in one stroke to unbalance the foe.

name: Stately Inwardcurve
description: Spread the stance wide with qi in the legs and take blows from any side.

name: Inferno Lopstroke
description: Cross the foe with a gathered hew that needs no cover and leaves none.

name: Gloomnotch
description: Cut in a slow steady line until the foe finds no spot on the field to stand.

name: Intrepid Whump
description: Drive qi through the edge so the cut goes through any cover the foe can raise.

name: Notch Crown
description: Spend whatever qi the student has to give on one cut that no screen can hold back.

name: Illustrious Forwardbelly
description: Land from a leap with a chop already falling from the shoulder.

name: Kinkpledge
description: Raise the blade in the air above and take a falling strike on the crossed spine.

name: Vigor Pommelcap
description: Hop on a gust of wind from one stance to another across the foe's reach.

name: Sigil Bulgeedge
description: Hook the foe's wrist at the top of a leap and drag it down with the landing.

name: Quenched Chip
description: Rise up the face of a gust of qi and chop down from its crest.

name: Squall Chopmass
description: Skip back on the gale as the parry lands so the blow passes empty air.

name: Vigorcho
description: Hang on a held wind in the air and cut at the foe from above without falling.

name: Waistverdict
description: Gather the wind under both feet and come down with a hew carried by the whole gale.

name: Vaunted Slash
description: Strike the ground at landing and send a wave of cut wind through the foes nearby.

name: Heroic Kinkspine
description: Fall from a great height with the qi field behind the blade and cleave the guard.

name: Gashodyssey
description: Flash upward on the gale to a point over the foe and chop down at once.

name: Intrepid Heavytip Edict
description: Rise on all the gale the student can bind and fall in the school's final chop.

name: Haemal Horntang
description: Chop from the seat of the Core with the oath held at the top of the swing.

name: Waistvow
description: Curve the blade through the wind and sweep a strike off its line.

name: Skyborne Cho
description: Step with the weight of the Core so the foot lands without a sound.

name: Interstice Hookbelly
description: Read the wind on the skin and fix the bearing from the beat of the Core.

name: Slashcrown
description: Drag the curve across the target with Core qi in the belly so the edge bites deeper.

name: Masterful Gash
description: Set the notch on a caught blade and hold it with a steady pulse of Core qi.

name: Inwardcurve Seal
description: Take a strike on the curve and send its weight back around the belly at the striker.

name: Imperial Slash
description: Draw the Core's qi through the curve and cleave through a guard in one swing.

name: Bedrock Bulgeedge
description: Spin on one foot with the curve held out and sweep a ring of cuts around the stance.

name: Peerless Chopmass
description: Compress Core qi and the wind into one hair-fine cut that tears the strongest guard.

name: Haemalkink
description: Swear the whole Core to the wind and loose it in the school's closing cut.
